text:
nina: noticed a spike of GPU warm-pool join failures in ap-southeast-1 starting ~04:40 UTC. failures show KMS decrypt denied.

nina: logs: `decrypt error: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/infra-warmup is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource`

sam: that screams conditional IAM policy pushed last night. @alex any recent iam changes in that region?

alex: yes, a targeted least-priv change to KMS key policy to require sourceVpc condition. rollout was 03:30 UTC. probable mismatch: warm-pool uses NAT egress through shared VPC so sourceVpc condition fails. rolling policy back now.

infrabot: ALERT: warm-pool ap-southeast join-failures=42 in 12m; region=ap-southeast-1

priya: temp mitigation: can we add the warm-pool role as a key principal allowance while we fix the sourceVpc logic? low blast radius.
sam: doing that now. apply-key-override c-20250720-kms-temp by sam.

deploy-bot: Change c-20250720-kms-temp applied to key alias/aws/rdw-warmup by sam.

infrabot: METRIC: join-success increased from 8% -> 86% within 90s of key patch.

alex: postmortem actions: 1) update IAM rollout checklist to include verifying egress path vs key condition 2) add synthetic keystore decrypt alert tied to warm-pool join SLO 3) prefer SG-based key condition or tagging-based principal for infra roles.

nina: cost note: had to allocate +3 spare GPU nodes in us-east to cover customer SLOs while ap recovered, incremental cost ~ $9/hr; tagging incident cost.

priya: thanks all. I'll create INF-2025-900 to track the policy change + CI test for decrypt with warm-pool egress patterns. Leaving thread open 3h.
